name: Survive Falling for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Survive Falling for Brainrots 🧠

Don't fall while collecting as many Brainrots as you can. Stay alert, move fast, and Run your way to success!

How to play :
🏃 Run, and avoid falling down when the hexagon disappear
🧠 Collect Brainrots to earn money
💵 Upgrade your Brainrots to increase earnings
🏗️ Improve your base to unlock more storage slots
💤 Earn cash even while offline

👍 Support the game by liking and favoriting — and join the group for bonus rewards!
